say:0:1322417001:0.text: Magister, the villagers are gathering around something!
say:0:1322417001:0.source_cn: 主人，镇民们好像在围看什么！

say:1:1322417002:0.text: A notice. Let's see what this is about.
say:1:1322417002:0.source_cn: 是公告，我们也过去看看吧。

say:0:1322418001:0.text: Rodrigo's playing it smart—he's just saying Cyran "disappeared." Keeps the villagers from panicking.
say:0:1322418001:0.source_cn: 罗德里戈很聪明嘛，只说他失踪了，这样能把负面影响降到最低。

say:1:1322418002:0.text: Then why put up a bounty poster at all?
say:1:1322418002:0.source_cn: 可为什么他要贴这么一张悬赏公告呢？

say:3:1322419002:0.text: What a surprise, Temesia! Do you have other things to take care of in Whiteridge?
say:3:1322419002:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅！你留在白山公国，是还有公务要处理吗？

say:4:1322419003:0.text: With the cultists still hanging around, Dame Temesia is staying to help guide the brainwashed villagers back to the righteous path, alongside the local acolytes.
say:4:1322419003:0.source_cn: 漏网的邪教徒还在附近作祟，所以特弥希娅大人会暂时留下，...

say:6:1322419007:1.text: Captain Rodrigo filled me in on the situation.
say:6:1322419007:1.source_cn: 白山诸多事宜，我已经从罗德里戈侍卫长这里听说了。

say:7:1322419008:1.text: Regarding Cyran... his involvement is suspicious, for sure, but we're dealing with a court mage here—a man with power, prestige, and deep political ties. The temple can't just launch an open investigation against him without cause.
say:7:1322419008:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷的所作所为的确很可疑，但他是帝国中一位很有威望...

say:8:1322419009:1.text: That's why I suggested Rodrigo issue a bounty instead. If we frame it as an internal matter for the Whiteridge Court, we might get some leads.
say:8:1322419009:1.source_cn: 所以我才建议罗德里戈先生贴了那份悬赏公告，希望能够从白...

say:9:1322419010:1.text: But for now, our biggest priority is rooting out the cult and restoring the villagers' faith.
say:9:1322419010:1.source_cn: 不过眼下最着急的还是铲除邪教徒，解决民众的信仰问题。

say:10:1322419011:1.text: If the cult's gotten bold enough to start kidnapping people, it means they've been operating in the shadows for a while...
say:10:1322419011:1.source_cn: 这里的邪教发展到了镇民失踪的程度，看来已经传播了不短的...

say:11:1322419012:1.text: And I failed to stop it. This is on me...

say:12:1322419013:1.text: No, this is a failure of the temple. When faith wavers, it's our duty to restore it. That's why I'm here.
say:12:1322419013:1.source_cn: 不，民众信仰动摇是教会的直接责任，我也是为此来到白山的。

say:13:1322419014:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?
say:13:1322419014:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?
say:13:1322419014:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?

choice_prompt:14:1322419014.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?
choice_prompt:14:1322419014.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，调查邪教徒的事您有什么想法吗？
choice_prompt:14:1322419014.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?
choice_prompt:14:1322419014.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how do you think we should go about investigating the cult?

say:15:1322419015:0.text: Well, the cult has been here a long time...
say:15:1322419015:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，现在邪教徒渗透已久……
say:15:1322419015:0.male: Well, the cult has been here a long time...
say:15:1322419015:0.female: Well, the cult has been here a long time...

say:16:1322419016:1.text: If we start arresting people now, it could backfire... The town might turn against us.
say:16:1322419016:1.source_cn: 这个节点将镇民逮捕的话……我担心会引起民众的反抗心理。

say:17:1322419019:1.text: I'll handle that part. As a templar knight, it's my duty to restore their faith and lead them back to the right path.
say:17:1322419019:1.source_cn: 民众的信仰问题就交给我吧，我会负责引领他们回到正途。身...

choice_prompt:18:1322419019.text: I'll handle that part. As a templar knight, it's my duty to restore their faith and lead them back to the right path.
choice_prompt:18:1322419019.source_cn: 民众的信仰问题就交给我吧，我会负责引领他们回到正途。身为圣堂骑士，这是我应尽的义务。

say:19:1322419020:1.text: It's an honor to work alongside you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But be careful, these people are fanatics. They won't go down without a fight.
say:19:1322419020:1.male: It's an honor to work alongside you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But be careful, these people are fanatics. They won't go down without a fight.
say:19:1322419020:1.female: It's an honor to work alongside you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But be careful, these people are fanatics. They won't go down without a fight.

say:21:1322419021:1.text: I appreciate the concern, but if anyone should be worried, it's those cultists. It's <style="stress"><player_name></style> they're dealing with, after all.
say:21:1322419021:1.source_cn: 感谢你的好意，不过作为<style=stress><p...

say:24:1322419022:1.text: That's right! If those brainwashed freaks so much as look at Magister the wrong way, Chippy will destroy every last one of them!
say:24:1322419022:1.source_cn: 没错！有满满在，对主人不怀好意者，满满都会将他们全数消...

say:25:1322419023:1.text: Haha, you familiars are as loyal as you are fierce!
say:25:1322419023:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你们两位使魔还是那么忠心和有趣。

say:26:1322419024:1.text: Thank you all. With you on our side, I'm sure Whiteridge will be back to normal soon.
say:26:1322419024:1.source_cn: 多谢你们。有你们的帮助，相信白山很快就会恢复往日的秩序。

say:28:1322419017:1.text: Agreed. Better to investigate from the shadows.
say:28:1322419017:1.source_cn: 没错，我也在想是不是暗中调查为好。

say:29:1322419018:1.text: Good point. The missing person cases have made some people question the cult. This is the perfect chance to reach out to them.
say:29:1322419018:1.source_cn: 是的，相信上次的失踪事件也会引起民众反思，这是我们接触...

say:0:1322420001:0.text: If we want to investigate the cult, we should start with the locals!
say:0:1322420001:0.source_cn: 调查邪教的话……我们可以找镇民们打听线索！

say:1:1322421001:1.text: The Archduke's dead, and there's still no word on a successor. Without leadership, how are we supposed to restore order in Whiteridge?!
say:1:1322421001:1.source_cn: 大公去世，迟迟没有新任大公的消息，白山想恢复秩序可不容...

choice_prompt:2:1322421001.text: The Archduke's dead, and there's still no word on a successor. Without leadership, how are we supposed to restore order in Whiteridge?!
choice_prompt:2:1322421001.source_cn: 大公去世，迟迟没有新任大公的消息，白山想恢复秩序可不容易啊……

say:3:1322421002:1.text: And who might you be, exactly? You've certainly got the aura of someone important, but I don't recall seeing you around before...
say:3:1322421002:1.source_cn: 这位大人，您……是谁啊？虽然看着确实很有气质，但咱们白...
say:3:1322421002:1.male: And who might you be, exactly? You've certainly got the aura of someone important, but I don't recall seeing you around before...
say:3:1322421002:1.female: And who might you be, exactly? You've certainly got the aura of someone important, but I don't recall seeing you around before...

say:4:1322421006:1.text: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...
say:4:1322421006:1.source_cn: 无论如何，只要雪松镇别出什么大乱子就可以了……
say:4:1322421006:1.male: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...
say:4:1322421006:1.female: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...

choice_prompt:5:1322421006.text: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...
choice_prompt:5:1322421006.source_cn: 无论如何，只要雪松镇别出什么大乱子就可以了……
choice_prompt:5:1322421006.male: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...
choice_prompt:5:1322421006.female: As long as Cedartown doesn't descend into complete chaos, that's good enough for me...

say:7:1322421011:1.text: I don't know anything, and I have better things to do. Bye...
say:7:1322421011:1.source_cn: 我什么都不知道，我还有事，先走了……
say:7:1322421011:1.male: I don't know anything, and I have better things to do. Bye...
say:7:1322421011:1.female: I don't know anything, and I have better things to do. Bye...

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 你认识传播伟大意志的教徒吗？

say:10:1322421010:1.text: If you're looking to talk religion...
say:10:1322421010:1.male: If you're looking to talk religion...
say:10:1322421010:1.female: If you're looking to talk religion...

choice:5:2:3.text: Tell me about the Great Will.
choice:5:2:3.male: Tell me about the Great Will.
choice:5:2:3.female: Tell me about the Great Will.

say:11:1322421007:1.text: Dura, the Great Will—whoever's watching over us, just keep Cedartown safe. That's all I ask.
say:11:1322421007:1.source_cn: 艾雅也好，伟大意志也好，保佑雪松镇吧。
say:11:1322421007:1.male: Dura, the Great Will—whoever's watching over us, just keep Cedartown safe. That's all I ask.
say:11:1322421007:1.female: Dura, the Great Will—whoever's watching over us, just keep Cedartown safe. That's all I ask.

say:12:1322421003:1.text: Captain Rodrigo? He's done a lot, sure, but one man isn't enough. Whiteridge needs a proper ruler, someone with experience, someone capable of holding this duchy together!
say:12:1322421003:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈大人……他的确做了很多事，但是光靠他是不够的，...
say:12:1322421003:1.male: Captain Rodrigo? He's done a lot, sure, but one man isn't enough. Whiteridge needs a proper ruler, someone with experience, someone capable of holding this duchy together!
say:12:1322421003:1.female: Captain Rodrigo? He's done a lot, sure, but one man isn't enough. Whiteridge needs a proper ruler, someone with experience, someone capable of holding this duchy together!

say:13:1322421004:1.text: You're right. But you should know that whenever disaster strikes, it's always us, the common folk, who suffer the most.
say:13:1322421004:1.source_cn: 唉，这位大人您说的对，但您不知道无论什么灾难，最后遭殃...
say:13:1322421004:1.male: You're right. But you should know that whenever disaster strikes, it's always us, the common folk, who suffer the most.
say:13:1322421004:1.female: You're right. But you should know that whenever disaster strikes, it's always us, the common folk, who suffer the most.

say:14:1322421005:1.text: People like us... we don't have the power to change things. "Hope" isn't something we can afford.
say:14:1322421005:1.source_cn: 我们没什么本事……信心光靠自己可是给不了的……
say:14:1322421005:1.male: People like us... we don't have the power to change things. "Hope" isn't something we can afford.
say:14:1322421005:1.female: People like us... we don't have the power to change things. "Hope" isn't something we can afford.

say:1:1322422001:1.text: Excuse me! Where did you first hear about the Great Will?
say:1:1322422001:1.source_cn: 劳驾！请问你在哪里得知伟大意志的呢？

say:2:1322422002:1.text: Where? Look around. Everyone in town is talking about it. You could plug your ears and still hear whispers of the "true god."
say:2:1322422002:1.source_cn: 在哪里得知？瞧瞧现在的雪松镇上吧，所有人都在议论，就算...

say:3:1322422003:1.text: However, now that you mention it, I can't quite recall where I first heard it.
say:3:1322422003:1.source_cn: 不过……到底是在哪里得知的来着？

say:4:1322422004:1.text: Wait a second, who are you? Why are you asking about this? What does it matter to you?! You shouldn't be prying into divine matters! The Great Will does not tolerate doubt. Questioning the divine brings misfortune!
say:4:1322422004:1.source_cn: 话说回来，你们又是谁？问这些干嘛！告诉你们又怎样？哼，...

say:0:1322423001:0.text: The second we mention the Great Will, they start mincing words...
say:0:1322423001:0.source_cn: 一提到伟大意志，镇民们都很戒备呢……

say:1:1322423002:0.text: Maybe kids will be less guarded? Let's try talking to them.
say:1:1322423002:0.source_cn: 或许小孩子没那么多戒心？我们找孩子们问问吧！

say:0:1322424001:0.text: Look over there, Magister! Some kids!
say:0:1322424001:0.male: Look over there, Magister! Some kids!
say:0:1322424001:0.female: Look over there, Magister! Some kids!

say:1:1322425001:1.text: You've entered my domain, and that means you must follow my rules!
say:1:1322425001:1.source_cn: 你们踏入了我的领地，就要听从我的指挥！

say:4:1322425004:1.text: Ahem... Your Highness, forgive our intrusion, but we could not possibly pass through your domain without first offering our respects.
say:4:1322425004:1.source_cn: 咳咳……殿下，我们经由您的领地，怎可不来打声招呼，献上...

say:5:1322425005:1.text: Hah! Now that's the proper attitude!

say:6:1322425006:1.text: I heard there's been a lot of turmoil in your domain lately—strange forces at play. Some so-called prophets of the Great Will have gained quite the following among the people. Are you aware of this?
say:6:1322425006:1.source_cn: 我听说您的领地最近波澜四起，诡谲潜伏，有些自称伟大意志...

say:7:1322425007:1.text: Uh... what? Strange... what now? Speak plain English!
say:7:1322425007:1.source_cn: 呃，什么……诡……？什么意思？你还是说白话吧。

say:8:1322425008:1.text: They're asking if any priests have been going around preaching about the Great Will.
say:8:1322425008:1.source_cn: 他问你最近地盘上有没有一些伟大意志的传教士。

say:9:1322425009:1.text: Oh, yeah. I've seen them. But...

say:10:1322425010:1.text: But what? Tell us anything you know, Your Highness!

say:11:1322425011:1.text: Oh, I could, but you'll have to beat us first! Take this!
say:11:1322425011:1.source_cn: 不过你得打赢我们！看招！

say:12:1322425012:1.text: Ow! Snowballs?! Haha... you messed with the wrong people!
say:12:1322425012:1.source_cn: 哎哟！是雪球！哈哈……我的主人也不是吃素的！
say:12:1322425012:1.male: Ow! Snowballs?! Haha... you messed with the wrong people!
say:12:1322425012:1.female: Ow! Snowballs?! Haha... you messed with the wrong people!

say:1:1322426001:0.text: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!
say:1:1322426001:0.source_cn: 你赢了！想问什么就问吧！
say:1:1322426001:0.male: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!
say:1:1322426001:0.female: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!

choice_prompt:2:1322426001.text: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!
choice_prompt:2:1322426001.source_cn: 你赢了！想问什么就问吧！
choice_prompt:2:1322426001.male: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!
choice_prompt:2:1322426001.female: Alright, alright, you win! Ask away!

say:3:1322426002:0.text: Oh, those fanatics who won't shut up about it? Ha! Only a complete fool would buy into that nonsense!
say:3:1322426002:0.source_cn: 那些满嘴伟大意志的家伙吗？哈哈，也只有真正的傻瓜才会信...
say:3:1322426002:0.male: Oh, those fanatics who won't shut up about it? Ha! Only a complete fool would buy into that nonsense!
say:3:1322426002:0.female: Oh, those fanatics who won't shut up about it? Ha! Only a complete fool would buy into that nonsense!

say:4:1322426003:1.text: Yeah, a lot of people in town have been whispering about this Great Will and...
say:4:1322426003:1.source_cn: 最近镇子上确实有不少人悄悄摸摸地说这个伟大意志，让我想想……
say:4:1322426003:1.male: Yeah, a lot of people in town have been whispering about this Great Will and...
say:4:1322426003:1.female: Yeah, a lot of people in town have been whispering about this Great Will and...

say:5:1322426004:1.text: Oh, right! They're planning some kind of gathering soon! As for where... no clue. They always huddle up and talk in hushed voices!
say:5:1322426004:1.source_cn: 对了！他们近期要举办个礼拜之类的活动！地点嘛……我就不...
say:5:1322426004:1.male: Oh, right! They're planning some kind of gathering soon! As for where... no clue. They always huddle up and talk in hushed voices!
say:5:1322426004:1.female: Oh, right! They're planning some kind of gathering soon! As for where... no clue. They always huddle up and talk in hushed voices!

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 关于伟大意志你知道些什么？

say:6:1322426005:0.text: Lev? Uh, there's more than one Lev in town, you know.
say:6:1322426005:0.source_cn: 列夫？呃，镇子里好几个列夫呢……
say:6:1322426005:0.male: Lev? Uh, there's more than one Lev in town, you know.
say:6:1322426005:0.female: Lev? Uh, there's more than one Lev in town, you know.

say:7:1322426006:1.text: Any of them seem strange to you?
say:7:1322426006:1.source_cn: 有没有特别奇怪的列夫？

say:8:1322426007:1.text: Strange? Oh, yeah, there's this drifter by that name. Smells awful, sings weird songs. Creeps people out, that one.
say:8:1322426007:1.source_cn: 奇怪的……啊，对，有个外来的流浪汉就叫列夫，脏兮兮的，...

say:10:1322426009:1.text: Hah! That guy? He can barely take care of himself! No way he's got a sister.
say:10:1322426009:1.source_cn: 哈！怎么可能，他连自己都快饿死了，从没听说他有妹妹。

choice:2:1:2.text: Do you know a guy named Lev?
choice:2:1:2.male: Do you know a guy named Lev?
choice:2:1:2.female: Do you know a guy named Lev?

say:11:1322426010:0.text: Irina... doesn't ring a bell. She from around here?
say:11:1322426010:0.source_cn: 伊琳娜……我怎么没什么印象？她是雪松镇上的人吗？
say:11:1322426010:0.male: Irina... doesn't ring a bell. She from around here?
say:11:1322426010:0.female: Irina... doesn't ring a bell. She from around here?

say:14:1322426011:0.text: Wait, boss! I know that girl!
say:14:1322426011:0.source_cn: 格列布大哥，嗯，我知道这个女孩！我知道！

say:15:1322426012:0.text: She lives next to me. Her dad's a drunk. Yells at her all the time. She never really talks to anyone. Kind of a weird one.
say:15:1322426012:0.source_cn: 我家住她家隔壁，她父亲经常喝醉酒大声吼她，嗯，她也不怎...

say:16:1322426013:0.text: Wait, she lives in town? Then why doesn't she ever play with us?
say:16:1322426013:0.source_cn: 啊？你确定有这号人吗？那她为什么不来跟我们玩？

say:17:1322426014:0.text: Well, everyone said she was a bit odd. Guess that's why she keeps to herself.
say:17:1322426014:0.source_cn: 嗯，都说她有点奇奇怪怪的了，不来玩也正常嘛！

say:20:1322426016:1.text: Oh, it's nothing! Hehe... but hey, you'll come visit us again, right?
say:20:1322426016:1.source_cn: 没什么！嘿嘿！不过……你们还会来找我们吗？

choice_prompt:21:1322426016.text: Oh, it's nothing! Hehe... but hey, you'll come visit us again, right?
choice_prompt:21:1322426016.source_cn: 没什么！嘿嘿！不过……你们还会来找我们吗？

say:22:1322426017:1.text: Stop calling me that! We're friends now!
say:22:1322426017:1.source_cn: 不要叫我殿下啦，我们现在是朋友了！
say:22:1322426017:1.male: Stop calling me that! We're friends now!
say:22:1322426017:1.female: Stop calling me that! We're friends now!

say:25:1322426018:1.text: Awesome! Next time, I'll teach you a new game! Get ready to lose big time!
say:25:1322426018:1.source_cn: 好啊好啊！下次我教你玩别的！你一定不是我们的对手！
say:25:1322426018:1.male: Awesome! Next time, I'll teach you a new game! Get ready to lose big time!
say:25:1322426018:1.female: Awesome! Next time, I'll teach you a new game! Get ready to lose big time!

choice:2:3:4.text: That's all I had to ask.
choice:2:3:4.male: That's all I had to ask.
choice:2:3:4.female: That's all I had to ask.

say:0:1322427001:0.source_cn: 终于有进展了！接下来呢？

say:1:1322427002:0.text: Rezek, the hunter from Petalia Plains, mentioned the Great Will. Let's go see what he knows.
say:1:1322427002:0.source_cn: 繁花原野的猎人雷兹克提到过伟大意志，我们找他问问吧。

say:1:1322430001:1.text: Oh, it's you guys. What's up?

say:2:1322430002:1.text: Hang on, whatever it is, it'll have to wait. I've been tracking that deer for ages, and it keeps slipping past my traps...
say:2:1322430002:1.source_cn: 等下，有啥事也等会再说，我盯着那头鹿很久了，但这家伙居...

say:3:1322430003:1.text: I swear on Dura, I will catch that thing today!
say:3:1322430003:1.source_cn: 我向艾雅女神起誓，一定要抓住这头狡猾的鹿！

say:5:1322430005:1.text: You must have been sent by Dura herself!
say:5:1322430005:1.source_cn: 赞美女神，你们一定是女神派来的！

say:1:1322431001:1.text: Well, I'll be damned. You really are Dura's chosen. This haul will fetch me a fine price.
say:1:1322431001:1.source_cn: 哈！真不愧是女神的使者。艾雅保佑，这头鹿能让我换不少钱呢。

say:2:1322431002:1.text: Alright, you've earned my time. What do you need?

say:8:1322431007:1.text: Do you know how often they gather? Any pattern?

say:9:1322431008:1.text: No clue. I only saw them once by accident.
say:9:1322431008:1.source_cn: 这我就不清楚了，我也只是碰上过一次。

say:10:1322431009:1.text: Lev? Never heard of that name.
say:10:1322431009:1.source_cn: 没听过这个名字，不认识。
say:10:1322431009:1.male: Lev? Never heard of that name.
say:10:1322431009:1.female: Lev? Never heard of that name.

say:11:1322431010:1.text: Irina... yeah, I know that kid. She's had it rough. Poor girl...
say:11:1322431010:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜……我知道那孩子，她是个让人心疼的孩子啊……
say:11:1322431010:1.male: Irina... yeah, I know that kid. She's had it rough. Poor girl...
say:11:1322431010:1.female: Irina... yeah, I know that kid. She's had it rough. Poor girl...

say:12:1322431011:1.text: I know her old drunk of a father, so I'd always say hi whenever I saw her, but she never once answered me.
say:12:1322431011:1.source_cn: 我认识她的酒鬼老爹，所以我见到伊琳娜总是会打声招呼，但...

say:13:1322431012:1.text: But one time, I got injured out in the wild. I was dragging myself back home, bleeding all over the place, and Irina saw me. That night, she showed up at my door with a pot of mushroom soup.

say:15:1322431014:1.text: *Sigh* She's a good kid. Thoughtful. Kind. A damn sight better than her drunk father ever gave her credit for. Dura above! That bastard doesn't deserve her.
say:15:1322431014:1.source_cn: 唉，她这么心细温柔的孩子……跟她那酒鬼老爹嘴里形容的完...

say:16:1322431015:1.text: You folks in a hurry? If not, I could fix up some venison for you.
say:16:1322431015:1.source_cn: 你们不着急的话，我回去收拾好鹿肉招待你们。

say:17:1322431016:1.text: Appreciate it, but we gotta go.
say:17:1322431016:1.source_cn: 感谢大叔，我们还有事要先走了。

say:18:1322431017:1.text: That busy, huh? Well, take care out there. May Dura bless you all.
say:18:1322431017:1.source_cn: 这么急啊……那就只能谢谢你们了，愿女神保佑你们。

say:0:1322432001:0.text: Magister, we've gathered plenty of intel. Time to report back to Rodrigo.
say:0:1322432001:0.source_cn: 主人，我们收获了不少情报，回去跟罗德里戈说说吧！

say:1:1322433001:1.text: Didn't expect you to dig up clues this fast.
say:1:1322433001:1.source_cn: 没想到你们这么迅速就查到线索了。

say:2:1322433002:1.text: These cultists have already started holding gatherings. We need to act fast and come up with a plan.
say:2:1322433002:1.source_cn: 这群邪教徒已经开始组织礼拜，我们得尽快了解情况，制定对策。
